title: S1: replaceLocalWithICloud never deletes local data

description: runMigration (MigrationCoordinator.swift:245-348) has no op-specific wipe step - it just attaches mirroring. Local rows upload and MERGE with iCloud, even though the UI promises this action 'permanently replaces this device's data'. MigrationPhase.removingLocalStore exists as a case but is never emitted by any migration path - the designed step was never wired up. Severity: Critical. Wave/Plan: Wave 2, plan 2a migration-transitions. Sweep: sync machinery. Verified directly against source.
